{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Baron}}
[[File:Fel-barony.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] receives the baton signifying the rank of Baron of the Empire from [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine.]]
'''Baron of the Empire''' was a title bestowed upon servants of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for outstanding service to it, similar to the titles of [[Tan (title)|Tan]] (for exceptional starfighter pilots) and [[Warlord of the Empire]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] granted the title to [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], an Imperial starfighter ace, for his excellent performance at the [[Battle of Derra IV]].<ref name="TNEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> With the title came a baton signifying the rank and an [[Fel estate|estate]], in Fel's case on his homeworld of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="TMOBF">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref>
